name: Independent Assurance and Governed Scale Certification Readiness
objective: Establish the controlled readiness layer for independent assurance of climate/ESG data, DMRV controls and governed-scale claims, without representing readiness as completed assurance or certification.

independence: management/owner attestation separated from independent conclusion

standards_basis.ifrs_s2: Alignment/readiness mapping to governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets; materiality and applicable jurisdictional requirements remain subject to the reporting entity.
standards_basis.ghg_protocol: Use current applicable GHG Protocol requirements/guidance for organizational and operational boundaries and Scope 1/2/3 accounting; methodology version and change control are mandatory.
standards_basis.esrs_e1: Use the current adopted ESRS requirements applicable to the reporting perimeter and jurisdiction. The EFRAG Knowledge Hub currently identifies the 2026 revised ESRS Delegated Act as the latest version; prior technical advice/drafts must not be presented as adopted requirements.

fail_closed: unresolved material exception without documented disposition
physical product release inferred from assurance readiness
